title: spec: `app.hidden: true` on a stored app is rewritten to `_unpublished: true` by the appHiddenToUnpublished conversion replayed on stored rows — after publish-drafts the app shows again; after a per-item publish it vanishes for non-builders
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

`hidden` is documented as navigation-only, never an access gate. A stored app that declares it loses the intent: depending on how it is published the app either reappears in the switcher and Home, or disappears entirely for members (404).

## Reproduction

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/qa_hidden_app?mode=draft&package=PKG` body `{"name":"qa_hidden_app","label":"Hidden App","hidden":true,"navigation":[{"id":"h1","type":"object","objectName":"<obj>"}]}` → 200.
2. `GET …?state=draft&package=PKG` → no `hidden`, `_unpublished: true`.
3. (a) `publish-drafts` → served `_unpublished:false`, no `hidden` → the app is visible in the switcher/Home.
4. (b) per-item publish or an active PUT → effective `_unpublished:true` → a non-builder member `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=…` → `[]`, `GET /api/v1/meta/app/qa_hidden_app` → 404; admin still sees it.

## Expected

A stored `hidden: true` round-trips as `hidden` (navigation-only), as the spec documents; the conversion applies only to the legacy shape it was written for.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` `appHiddenToUnpublished`, replayed by `applyConversionsToStoredItem`.

## Filing facts

- reach: `/api/v1/meta/app` save + publish doors, measured by the Interfaces QA card; coordinator re-verified.
- Business reason: Admins who hide an app from navigation either fail to hide it or accidentally make it unreachable for everyone but builders.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:studio`, p1.
- Dedupe: semantic search `app hidden rewritten to _unpublished by appHiddenToUnpublished conversion on stored app` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 4 hits, all closed (#6955, #6954 — the #4829 family; #20290, #5242 unrelated).
- QA id: S2
